jobs.title: Software Engineer: Frontend
jobs.description: Build interactive frontend experiences for an AI communications platform. Live official ATS posting verified; no degree minimum stated.
jobs.eligibilityEvidence: The employer explicitly hires globally regardless of time zone. Pakistan is geographically covered; meeting/trial acceptance remains unresolved in requirements.

requirements.text: Frontend architecture for interactive data interfaces.
requirements.explanation: Production React interfaces, Redux Toolkit/RTK Query, shared APIs and Illume analytics provide direct evidence of data fetching, state and rendering work.

requirements.text: Own the product lifecycle and manage asynchronous remote work.
requirements.explanation: Tututor product/engineering ownership, leading developers, direct founder work and sustained remote delivery support this expectation.

requirements.text: Clear asynchronous communication and fluent written English.
requirements.explanation: International collaboration and leadership support communication experience, but the supplied facts do not confirm written-English fluency. Ask the candidate rather than inferring a language level.

requirements.text: Build unit/E2E suites and measure shipped features with analytics.
requirements.explanation: Cypress, golden tests and analytics dashboards are relevant evidence. Ownership of both unit and end-to-end suites plus product instrumentation is not explicit. This is a role responsibility, included to expose the remaining scope question, not an invented framework requirement.

requirements.text: Commit to a paid two-week full-time or four-week part-time trial.
requirements.explanation: Immediate availability does not establish acceptance of this particular commitment. Candidate confirmation is required.

requirements.text: Attend Monday and Friday meetings at 14:30 GMT.
requirements.explanation: This is 19:30 Pakistan time. The candidate has not confirmed these recurring hours.

jobs.notes: Source reviewed against candidate-provided resume/portfolio evidence. Strong technical potential, with specific unresolved items above. Not application-ready. Employer identity is corroborated by whippy.ai linking this Ashby board. No named referral contact was verified. The public application route requires JavaScript; its complete question set was not inspected. No submission was made.
jobs.nextAction: Confirm written English, testing/instrumentation scope, meeting hours and paid-trial commitment; then inspect every application question before preparing submission.
